provenance.note: White Pine HourlyAQObs for 1 December 2025 through 28 February 2026, and the HRRR f00 analysis byte ranges for the three inversion days and two control days. No API key. boise is the decoded cell from those ranges. inversionRule stays quiet on all five days because the PM term never reaches 101.

airnow.clock: ValidDate and ValidTime match the UTC hour in the file name. Local date is America/Boise, UTC-7 for this window.
airnow.value: PM25 is the hourly concentration in UG/M3. PM25_AQI is the integer in that column, copied as reported. It is not recomputed from PM25.

hrrr.index: The sibling .idx. start is the byte offset on that line. end is the next message offset.
hrrr.grid: Each range is the full CONUS message. boise is the nearest Lambert cell to place, i 399, j 770, index 1385629.

screen.result: No screened day reached 35.5 ug/m3. The highest were 1 January and 14 December at 30 ug/m3. The 15:00Z probe on 15 December sits outside the four screen hours, so that day's screen count is 5.

provenance.selection: 13-15 January 2026 are the inversion days. 14 and 15 January are the only full days whose hourly PM2.5 crossed 35.5 ug/m3, at 37 and 38. 13 January is the buildup day before that pair, at 31 ug/m3. Reported PM25_AQI on those three peaks is 86, 94, and 98. The highest reported PM25_AQI on 14 January is also 94, on the following hour at 32 ug/m3. 17 December 2025 and 24 December 2025 are the control days. Hourly peaks are 7 ug/m3 (reported PM25_AQI 21 at that hour, 24 an hour later) and 3 ug/m3 (reported PM25_AQI 28). 16 February peaked at 7 ug/m3 (reported PM25_AQI 32 at 2026-02-16T09:00:00Z). The highest reported PM25_AQI that day was 39, at 6 ug/m3 two hours earlier. It was left out because 24 December's hourly peak was 3. 8 January peaked at 15 ug/m3 and was not used as a control.

boise.note: Nearest HRRR CONUS Lambert cell to place. The index is j * nx + i. TMP at 2 m, HPBL at the surface, and MASSDEN at 8 m were read with readLambertPoint from the byte range on that hrrr hour. UGRD and VGRD at 10 m are simple-packed, so the same index was unpacked with the readSimpleGribFields scale. correctedAqi is pm25TenthsToAqi of concentrationTokenToTenths on MASSDEN in kg/m3. Thresholds were not changed. eccodes grib_ls at this latitude and longitude matched 2026-01-13T12:00:00Z, 2026-01-13T23:00:00Z, 2026-01-14T00:00:00Z, and 2025-12-24T12:00:00Z.
